translationRepairs: The city garrison clamored to join Chen Youlong, but Ershu pulled his men back to hold Baqing, asked Youde for reinforcements, and fought the enemy to a standstill on the Ziyang River.
The city garrison clamored to join Chen Youlong, but Ershu pulled his men back to hold Baoqing, asked Youde for reinforcements, and fought the enemy to a standstill on the Ziyang River.
s0006 has 退守寶慶; 寶慶 is Baoqing, so Baqing is a misspelling. The proposed replacement corrects only that place name.

Censor He Kehua memorialized again, accusing Yanzhu of treating the rebels Shi Jiqing and Guan Desheng Fu too lightly and of releasing Wang Tianfu and Han Wangxi without punishment; lumped together with the Jintan affair, Yanzhu was also sentenced to strangulation.

Censor He Kehua memorialized again, accusing Yanzhu of applying light statutes to the rebel criminals Shi Jiqing and Guan Desheng, and of releasing Wang Tianfu and Han Wangxi without punishment; lumped together with the Jintan affair, Yanzhu was also sentenced to strangulation.

s0065 reads 讞從叛罪人史記青、管得勝傅輕比: 管得勝 is the personal name and 傅輕比 is the legal verb phrase for applying a light statutory comparison. Guan Desheng Fu wrongly fuses 傅 into the name; the proposed idiomatic wording removes that error and renders 傅輕比 accurately.

Censor He Kehua again memorialized impeaching Yanzhu for leniently comparing the rebel criminals Shi Jiqing and Guan Desheng Fu, and for releasing without sentence Wang Tianfu and Han Wangxi; together with the Jintan case he too was sentenced to strangulation.

Censor He Kehua again memorialized impeaching Yanzhu for applying light comparisons to the rebel criminals Shi Jiqing and Guan Desheng, and for releasing without sentence Wang Tianfu and Han Wangxi; together with the Jintan case he too was sentenced to strangulation.

Same parsing as the idiomatic line: after 管得勝 the text continues with 傅輕比, a legal verb phrase, not a name element Fu. The proposed literal replacement correctly ends the name at Guan Desheng and renders 傅輕比 as applying light comparisons.
When the Dantu rebel Wang Zai rose in arms, Tikun again sent dozens of clerks and elders to offer submission—and they looted the treasury and fled.
When the Dantu rebel Wang Zaixing rose in arms, Tikun again sent dozens of clerks and elders to offer submission—and they looted the treasury and fled.
s0056 has 丹徒亂民王再興兵起: 王再興 is the three-character personal name, followed by 兵起. Reading 王再 plus 興兵 mis-splits the name; Wang Zaixing is the correct restoration.

At Shanchansi in Shanquan, Yixing, monks were locked in a land dispute with powerful families; a mob burned the temple and killed monks. The magistrate reported an uprising and senior officials prepared to send troops.

In the Shanquan mountains of Yixing, temple monks were locked in a land dispute with powerful families; a mob burned the temple and killed monks. The magistrate reported an uprising and senior officials prepared to send troops.
s0115 has 宜興善權山中寺僧: 善權山中寺 means a temple in the Shanquan mountains of Yixing, not a toponym Shanchansi. The proposed wording restores that reading without inventing a place name.
Seeing those who had once shaved their heads in the Ming style, Pengju said: "These are innocent people caught up in the affair—they should be spared."
Seeing those who had already shaved their heads, Pengju said: "These are innocent people caught up in the affair—they should be spared."

s0143 has 嘗薙發者: 薙發 is the Qing-required tonsure/queue, evidence of submission as 良民. The idiomatic gloss invents Ming style, which the Chinese does not support; removing that phrase corrects the error.
